metadata.outcome_period: annual U.S. statistical lives conditional on future PEC deployment
metadata.interpretation: This is a prospective probabilistic model of potential outcomes conditional on future Public Emergency Codes deployment. PEC has not generated deployment outcome data from which a PEC-specific causal effect can be estimated. The model does not estimate the probability that deployment itself will occur.
metadata.elicitation_status: Interim author-specified priors pending independent SHELF/Delphi-style elicitation. No independent expert-panel results are claimed.

near_term_prospective_scenario.name: Near-Term Prospective Gross Mortality-Benefit Scenario

annual_988_external_association.unit: fewer deaths per year associated with the whole national 988 rollout
annual_988_external_association.evidence_tier: observed external association, not a PEC effect

pec_share_of_988_association.source: Interim pre-deployment attribution prior; formal independent elicitation pending

causal_fraction_of_988_association.source: Observational association; genuine no-causal-effect state included. The primary slab follows the observed beneficial sign; a full sign-reversal stress is reported separately.

prospective_988_affected_episode_model.status: Prospective affected-episode denominator shared with the economic model; the external 988 association and PEC attribution remain aggregate and are not observed jointly with this denominator

near_term_prospective_scenario.cpr_category_source: Nguyen et al. 2024, observed category-specific survival; weights approximated from the published distribution figure and constrained to the reported 10 percent at 10+ minutes. The current recovered-time prior is bounded at 1 minute, so the one-category cap cannot bind; a future prior above 2 minutes requires a multi-category transition model.
near_term_prospective_scenario.language_transport_status: General medical-911 prevalence transported to OHCA; zero-effect state included. A separate 0-to-1 attenuation factor represents residual confounding and causal transport of the observational timing-survival contrast.

access_sensitivity.status: Prospective cross-endpoint sensitivity only; excluded from the primary near-term gross-benefit scenario

future_mature_scenario.name: Future Mature Nationwide Deployment Scenario
future_mature_scenario.master_unit: unique emergency episode; one person may contribute multiple episodes per year
future_mature_scenario.episode_rule: Administrative records are converted to latent unique emergency episodes using pathway-specific repeat-record and cross-pathway allocation factors. Pathway labels identify the final transition/reporting category, not a single-function state: functions may overlap and act jointly within an episode, but each episode receives one final benefit/harm/none mortality outcome.
future_mature_scenario.implementation_index_rule: The four implementation quantities are nonserial national maturity indices because pathway success is already a conditional local workflow-completion probability after an eligible episode reaches the pathway. Pathway success excludes national population reach, user activation, platform reliability, and receiver-compatibility scale; their geometric mean supplies that separate national maturity adjustment. They must not be interpreted as four independent conditional probabilities multiplied in sequence.
future_mature_scenario.dependence_model: Equicorrelated Gaussian- and Student-t-copula sensitivities jointly cover shared national implementation and beneficial/adverse clinical multipliers as well as pathway-specific episode, success, effect, and effect-presence draws. Low, medium, and high dependence cases are reported; an empirically elicited correlation matrix remains pending.

pathways.name: 988/crisis connection
pathways.tier: external association plus prospective PEC prior

pathways.name: silent/language access
pathways.tier: transported process evidence plus prospective PEC prior

pathways.tier: local process evidence plus prospective PEC prior
